items.html: And this is their enumeration: since in the Atik, which is Arich Anpin, its two ears are not reckoned as two aspects but as a single ear, as is said in the Idra: "There is no left in this Atik; all is right." Likewise, the two eyes are reckoned as a single eye, as is said in Idra Rabba, page 129: "Nevertheless, they are two eyes and they return to being one."
